episodes.title: Open Government
episodes.summary: The Rt Hon Jim Hacker, newly appointed Minister for Administrative Affairs, finds his idealism challenged from the start.

episodes.title: The Official Visit
episodes.summary: Jim receives an African President, who turns out to be a friend from his university days.

episodes.title: The Economy Drive
episodes.summary: Jim attempts to initiate an economy drive within the Civil Service.

episodes.title: Big Brother
episodes.summary: Sir Humphrey is concerned about a new National Integrated Database.

episodes.title: The Writing on the Wall
episodes.summary: Jim Hacker MP is considering the introduction of identity cards.

episodes.title: The Right to Know
episodes.summary: Sir Humphrey is bothered by the controversy surrounding an endangered badger colony.

episodes.title: Jobs for the Boys
episodes.summary: Jim seeks help from a banker when a pet project seems near to collapse.

episodes.title: The Compassionate Society
episodes.summary: Minister for administrative affairs Jim Hacker struggles to cut administrative staff in the Health Service.

episodes.title: Doing the Honours
episodes.summary: Humphrey's old school network come in handy when he wants to scupper Jim's budget plans.

episodes.title: The Death List
episodes.summary: The minister is shocked to discover that his department is responsible for supplying all of the government's electronic surveillance equipment.

episodes.title: The Greasy Pole
episodes.summary: Jim discovers that the outcome of scientific reports can be manipulated if needs be.

episodes.title: The Devil You Know
episodes.summary: The date of a cabinet re-shuffle coincides with Jim's appointment in Brussels.

episodes.title: The Quality of Life
episodes.summary: Jim's eco-friendly policies are compromised when plans are hatched to turn a city farm into a Civil Service car park.

episodes.title: A Question of Loyalty
episodes.summary: Hacker and Sir Humphrey are called to appear before a Select Committee looking into government expenditure, and Hacker must choose between toeing the party line and doing what the Civil Service want him to do.

episodes.title: Equal Opportunities
episodes.summary: Jim attempts to instigate a policy of sexual equality in Whitehall, much to Sir Humphrey's disapproval.

episodes.title: The Challenge
episodes.summary: Jim's efforts to make local authorities financially accountable are thwarted by an interview with Ludovic Kennedy.

episodes.title: The Skeleton in the Cupboard
episodes.summary: A normally efficient local council is late with some paperwork, and Sir Humphrey wants to make an example of them.

episodes.title: The Moral Dimension
episodes.summary: Jim's plans to expose bribery are cancelled when Bernard manages to get a valuable vase under-valued, because Mrs Hacker has her eye on it.

episodes.title: The Bed of Nails
episodes.summary: Jim takes on an unpopular role developing a national transport policy.

episodes.title: The Whiskey Priest
episodes.summary: Jim faces opposition from all sides when he tries to expose a munitions deal.

episodes.title: The Middle-Class Rip-Off
episodes.summary: Jim and Sir Humphrey clash over those pillars of British culture: art and football.
